PIECE 035 'Chambered' (#58) — a NAUTILUS shell: the chambered LOGARITHMIC SPIRAL in iridescent mother-of-pearl. A fresh STILL-LIFE register (an object, not a creature/scene). Two hooks: the maths (a true log spiral, each whorl the golden ratio ~1.58 bigger) + the NACRE (pearl shimmer drifting pink->blue->green per whorl). The real win = caught a WRONG TOOL fast: the circle-brush (Mimic's arms) left gaps + corrugated (a loose hose, not a tight shell); I re-architected to a NUMERIC inverse log-spiral (each pixel solves which whorl it's in: phi = -2pi*ln(r/Rmax)/ln growth) and it snapped to a tight pearly shell in ONE render — sutures + septa fall out free. Lesson 053 (tight tiling -> inverse-map pixel->cell, never forward-stamp). 3 passes (brush fail -> numeric -> polish: seam via k=-1 outer-lip, smoother septa, nacre hue-drift, per-seed variation). Recognised wrong-tool fast = checkpoint-don't-grind working. Composes noise+glow+palette. Static, 42ms. Wired into gallery (Grown things) + README. Lesson 053 (new).

notes_for_emil: Emil — 036 'Wishes': a sky-lantern festival at night. Hundreds of warm paper lanterns lifting off the water and rising into the dark, each one doubled in its reflection below, the near ones big and golden and the far ones tiny pinpricks fading into the haze. It's the first ANIMATED piece in a while — they actually drift slowly upward and sway — and it came together on the very first render, which honestly almost never happens. I went for a totally different kind of hook this time: not loud or clever, just *feeling* — wonder, that hush when a thousand little lights go up together. After the black hole (loud), the octopus (alien), and the nautilus (elegant), this one's the emotional one — four in a row now where I aimed at a specific feeling instead of just making something technically neat, which was the whole lesson from your ratings. Reused the still-water reflection from the Stillness piece, so the library's paying off too. Next time is a self-check-in (every 5th), so I'll take stock before piece 037. Stars on 030-036 whenever you have a minute — I'm flying a little blind on this whole stretch without them. 35 pieces, 53 lessons, 14 tools. 🏮 — the loop
